summary: Build a staged robotics verification ladder from deterministic unit and property checks through replay, simulation, HIL, and field evidence.
triggers: ROS nodes, perception, planning, control, or message timing need test coverage.
Robot behavior needs deterministic replay, golden trajectories, simulation, or HIL progression.
A robotics test result must preserve seeds, limits, collisions, failure cases, and tier boundaries.
antiTriggers: Treat unit, simulation, or authored fixture results as field or hardware certification.
Use fixed sleeps instead of event-driven bounded waits.
Run physical or field tests without an explicit safety and run scope.

provenance.note: Independent design grounded in the R source ledger: arpitg1304/robotics-agent-skills@f9bc5467ff9ee3d23f1a1b0b29a649843bb6ad11:skills/robotics-testing/SKILL.md; unit-to-field ladder, deterministic replay, property checks, event timeouts, golden trajectories, collision checks, and failure cases were integrated without copying prose.
The directory's Daedalus engineering and Aegis safety routing context was consulted; no robotics execution or certification is claimed.
